tests.procedure: Under strong white light, check each received sample container separately in a clean transparent watch glass or glass dish for foreign particles, colour conformance and compliance with the visual specification.

tests.source: Siberian Ginseng Powder Extract__STM Siberian Ginseng Powder Extract 1-1.txt:30

tests.procedure: Weigh 100 mg powdered sample in a stoppered tube, add solvent stepwise (0.1 mL, then +0.9 mL, +2 mL, +7 mL), shaking vigorously 1 min and holding at 25.0 +/- 0.5 C for 15 min after each addition (repeat shake/hold once if not dissolved); classify very soluble / freely soluble / soluble / sparingly soluble by the volume at which it dissolves. If still undissolved, 10 mg in 10 mL (slightly soluble), then 1 mg in 10 mL (very slightly soluble), else practically insoluble. Repeat with ethanol.

details.sampleStart: 100 mg powdered sample in stoppered tube
details.shakePerStep: 1 min vigorous, then 15 min hold; repeat once if not dissolved
details.reference: BP (SC IV K.) Characters Section in Monographs (Hygroscopicity and Solubility)

tests.source: Siberian Ginseng Powder Extract__STM Siberian Ginseng Powder Extract 1-1.txt:32

tests.procedure: AAS (air-acetylene flame, lead hollow-cathode lamp, 283.31 nm). Calibrate with 1, 3 and 6 ppm lead standards prepared from Lead Standard Solution 1000 ppm diluted with water. Sample: 1 g, ash at about 600 C, add 10 mL conc. HCl + 10 mL distilled water, boil 5 min, transfer to a 25 mL volumetric flask, cool, make up with distilled water, filter. Blank with distilled water.

standardPrep.1ppm: Dilute 1 mL of the 1000 ppm standard to 1000 mL with water
standardPrep.3ppm: Dilute 3 mL of the 1000 ppm standard to 1000 mL with water
standardPrep.6ppm: Dilute 6 mL of the 1000 ppm standard to 1000 mL with water

sample.acid: 10 mL conc. HCl + 10 mL distilled water

details.reference: USP 2024 Chapter for Atomic Absorption Spectroscopy (852)

tests.procedure: Weighing bottle previously dried at 105 C, cooled in desiccator (W0). Weigh accurately 1.000 g sample into it (W1 = empty bottle + sample). Dry in calibrated oven at 105 C for 2 h, cool in desiccator, weigh (W2); repeat to constant weight. % LOD = (W1 - W2) / (W1 - W0) x 100.
tests.source: Siberian Ginseng Powder Extract__STM Siberian Ginseng Powder Extract 1-1.txt:34

tests.procedure: Crucible ignited at 600-650 C and cooled (W0). Weigh accurately 0.5 g sample (W1 = crucible + sample). Moisten with about 1 mL sulfuric acid, char gently on hot plate, cool, moisten residue with sulfuric acid again, heat gently until white fumes cease, ignite in calibrated muffle at 600-650 C, cool in desiccator, weigh (W2); repeat to constant weight. % Sulphated ash = (W2 - W0) / (W1 - W0) x 100.

details.reference: BP Appendix IX A. Determination of Sulfated Ash

tests.source: Siberian Ginseng Powder Extract__STM Siberian Ginseng Powder Extract 1-1.txt:35

tests.procedure: Aseptically, in validated LAF cabinet: weigh about 10 g sample in a sterile container, dissolve in SCDB' (Soybean Casein Digest broth + 4% polysorbate 20) to make 100 mL homogeneous suspension (DF 10). Process within 1 h of preparing the dilution. Pipette 1 mL into each of 4 sterile petri dishes; add 15-20 mL SCDA (melted, ~45 C) to the first 2 and SDA to the other 2; mix by tilting/rotating, solidify at room temperature. Incubate SCDA 48-72 h at 30-35 C (TAMC), SDA 5-7 days at 20-25 C (TYMC). Count colonies; CFU/g = (plate1 + plate2)/2 x DF. If no colonies: report 'less than DF' (e.g. <10).

tamc.medium: SCDA (Soybean Casein Digest Agar), 15-20 mL at ~45 C

tymc.medium: SDA (Sabouraud Dextrose Agar), 15-20 mL at ~45 C

details.formula: CFU/g = (colonies plate 1 + colonies plate 2) / 2 x DF
details.noGrowth: report as less than dilution factor CFU/g
details.reference: USP 2024 <2021> microbial enumeration tests - nutritional and dietary supplements; limits USP 2024 <2023>

tests.procedure: Same enumeration as RM-TAMC (shared test run): SDA plates, 5-7 days at 20-25 C, count and express as CFU/g (average of 2 plates x DF 10).
tests.source: Siberian Ginseng Powder Extract__STM Siberian Ginseng Powder Extract 1-1.txt:37

tests.procedure: New 1:50 dilution of the prepared SCDB' (same diluent), incubate 30-35 C for 24-48 h. Transfer 1 mL to 10 mL MacConkey Broth (MBP), incubate 42-44 C for 24-48 h. Subculture from both incubated media on MacConkey Agar (MAR), incubate 30-35 C for 18-24 h. Brick-red colonies (possible bile precipitate zone) = possible E. coli; confirm: Gram stain of isolated colonies (gram-negative short rods); EMB agar 30-35 C 24-48 h (dark-centred colonies with/without metallic sheen); TBX agar 42-44 C 18-72 h (blue or green colonies, no medium colour change); if possible ID system, present if probability > 70%.

plate.suspect: brick-red colonies, possible zone of precipitated bile

confirmatory: Gram stain of colonies on MAR: gram-negative short rods
EMB agar, 30-35 C, 24-48 h: dark-centred colonies with or without metallic sheen
TBX agar, 42-44 C, 18-72 h: blue or green colonies without change of medium colour
ID system if possible: present if probability > 70%
details.reference: USP 2024 <2022> Microbiological Procedures for absence of specified Microorganisms - Nutritional and Dietary Supplements

tests.source: Siberian Ginseng Powder Extract__STM Siberian Ginseng Powder Extract 1-1.txt:38

tests.procedure: Transfer 1 mL of the incubated SCDB' to 10 mL Rappaport Vassiliadis Salmonella Enrichment Broth (RVS), incubate 30-35 C for 18-24 h. Subculture on XLD, BGA or HEA, incubate 30-35 C for 24-48 h. Suspect: red colonies with/without black centres on XLD; small transparent colourless or opaque pink/white (often with pink-red zone) on BGA; blue-green colonies with/without black centres on HEA. Confirm: Gram stain (gram-negative short rods); TSI slant (alkaline red slant, acid yellow butt, with/without H2S blackening), 30-35 C 24-48 h; ID system if possible, present if probability > 70%.

confirmatory: TSI slant, 30-35 C, 24-48 h: alkaline (red) slant, acidic (yellow) butt, with or without H2S blackening
ID system if possible: present if probability > 70%
details.reference: USP 2024 <2022> Microbiological Procedures for absence of specified Microorganisms - Nutritional and Dietary Supplement
